# The Brand as the API Spells It

Version 1.9.3 matches logos to the brand names exactly as the Tankerkönig integration reports them, so Grüne and Roth Energie stations finally show their logo, and Gulf and TinQ get theirs.

## Logos

- **Grüne stations show their logo.** The integration reports these stations under the brand `Tankstelle Grüne`, not `Grüne`, so 1.9.2 still looked for the wrong file. The card now maps that brand to the Grüne logo. Thanks to @AHahne64 _[#106]_.
- **Roth Energie stations show their logo.** The brand is reported as `Roth- Energie`, with a stray space after the hyphen, and the card turned that into a double dash. The card now collapses repeated dashes, so it finds the logo _[#106]_.
- **Every TotalEnergies station gets the TotalEnergies logo.** Only stations with the exact brand `TotalEnergies` got it before. `TotalEnergies Autohof` and `TotalEnergies Truckstop` fell back to the generic pump. Thanks to @BobDerFette _[#106]_.
- **Gulf and TinQ have their own logos.** Stations of both brands showed the generic pump before. Thanks to @BobDerFette _[#106]_.

Nothing to change after updating.
